usage: tunnel recordings show [-h] [--base BASE] [--json] [--session NAME]
                              [--raw]
                              seq

positional arguments:
  seq             the seq from `tunnel recordings ls`

options:
  -h, --help      show this help message and exit
  --base BASE     where the admin API answers (default http://127.0.0.1:8000)
  --json          print raw JSON, errors included, for piping into jq
  --session NAME  which session (default: the one being recorded)
  --raw           print header values instead of [REDACTED]
